issues.description: Forbidden template placeholder: `url = ""  # CI fills this` is explicitly listed as a forbidden placeholder in code_style rule 5. The rule states this value should be filled by the adapter (适配者填写), not left empty for CI.
issues.fix_suggestion: Replace the empty url with the actual recipe repository URL, e.g. `url = "https://cnb.cool/<org>/<repo>.git"` or remove the attribute if the project convention requires CI to fill it post-merge (in which case document this exception).

issues.description: Missing shebang line. Code_style rule 1 requires conanfile.py files to start with `#!/usr/bin/env python3` followed by a docstring. The test_package/conanfile.py has a class docstring but no shebang.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add `#!/usr/bin/env python3` as the first line of the file.

issues.description: manifest.yaml uses key `software:` instead of `name:` as shown in the code_style rule 14 template. The rule example uses `name: zlib`.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider renaming `software:` to `name:` for consistency with the code style standard, or document this as an intentional schema deviation.

issues.description: Output format deviates from code_style rule 9. The script uses `[test]` prefix and emoji markers (✅/❌) instead of the standard `[step]`/`[ok]`/`[fail]` markers with 8-space indent alignment.
issues.fix_suggestion: Replace `[test]` with `[step]` and emoji with `[ok]`/`[fail]` (8-space indented) for consistency, e.g. `echo "[step] Testing echo..."` / `echo "        [ok] echo OK"`.

summary: PASS — No P0 (deceptive behavior) or P1 (recipe correctness) issues found. All P0 checks passed: (1) test_package/test.sh invokes the dash binary with 5 real functional tests (echo, arithmetic, function, loop, variable expansion) with output assertions — not an empty shell test; (2) test() method runs real tests, no skip/fake; (3) manifest.yaml status 'built' is accurate (conan-verified, not CI-uploaded); (4) sha256 'e7136826b1eed6ce3193e8affa2f70b1b2b9168dd91ffa7ddb4f46e9e62054fe' was verified by downloading the actual tarball from the official source and computing sha256sum — exact match; (5) test source file test.sh exists in changed_files.
